menu_options.local: One clock on this network (no cloud)

local.title: Doppler on this network
local.description: Control one clock directly, without Sandman's servers. The serial number is the clock's network name (for example Doppler-1a2b3c4d). The local key is stored on the clock itself.

error.cannot_connect: Can't reach the clock, or it reported a different serial number.
error.invalid_local_key: The clock rejected the local key.
